caption: The drawing features a square composition on a cream-colored background with a thin, dark border. Inside the square, there are five red flowers, each with a yellow circular center, and several green leaves arranged on branching green stems that spread diagonally from the bottom left to the top right. The stems and leaves are elongated and pointed. In the lower right corner, there is a semicircular, red basket or fan-like object with straight spokes radiating outwards and two light blue bows tied where the spokes meet the basket. At the bottom right of the red basket-like object, there is an oval shape outlined in red with some cursive writing inside. The colors used are predominantly red, green, yellow, light blue, and cream. The overall layout is geometric with floral and basket motifs.
title: Pieced Quilt (1 Square)
